payload.body: Crate CR-108 follow-up: Rust DELETE /api/me now preserves Crate's product-specific account deletion locally. A generic Frick account-deletion lifecycle must be hookable/configurable enough to allow Crate's non-cascade semantics: stamp User.revokedAt, clear provider/email identifiers, tombstone TenantMembership rows, revoke all sessions, but deliberately keep Tenant/InventoryItem/Release/shop history even for sole-owner deletes. Do not replace Crate's route with a generic cascade unless those semantics are expressible.
